flaws.description: Added legend=False to sns.scatterplot call and kept the explicit plt.legend line (which seaborn's hue= will override, so the legend is removed at source).
Replaced the y-axis label 'Impact Score (%)' with 'Improvement Rate (%)' to mislabel the vertical axis.
Filtered out the Mekong Delta region from the data frame passed to sns.scatterplot, removing its series.
